failure.summary: Four binding cases failed because the first fixture shadowed its fixture factory name and derived the catalog with Provider Binding revision 7 while the real Runtime verifier derives it with Runtime Tool revision 9.

fix.summary: Removed the lexical shadow and made the fixture derive the catalog exactly as McpRuntimeBindingAuthorityVerifier does. The binding suite then passed 5/5 and the expanded B02 focused suite passed 83/83.
